unresolvedFindings.title: Absence of Physical Manufacturing Metrology Data (L-PBF & CMM)
unresolvedFindings.description: No physical Laser Powder Bed Fusion (L-PBF) build logs, in-situ melt pool thermal camera telemetry, or Coordinate Measuring Machine (CMM) dimensional scan data exist. All evidence is purely mathematical and computational in software.
unresolvedFindings.impact: Strictly blocks verdict from being INDUSTRIALLY_QUALIFIED. Verdict is capped at SOFTWARE_VERIFIED_WITHIN_DECLARED_SCOPE.
unresolvedFindings.remediationPath: Integrate physical laser sintering machine telemetry and AS9102 First Article Inspection reports when physical specimens are fabricated.

unresolvedFindings.title: Absence of Algebraic Topology & Persistent Homology Algorithms

unresolvedFindings.impact: Excludes algebraic topology claims from platform specifications.
unresolvedFindings.remediationPath: Documented clearly in TOPOLOGY_CAPABILITY_TRUTH.json as NOT_IMPLEMENTED.

unresolvedFindings.title: Absence of Quantum & Solid-State DFT Physics Engines
